PART I

Item 1. Business

Acme Industrial Corp designs, manufactures, and services engineered machinery for logistics and food-processing customers. TOC-SENTINEL-BUSINESS marks the real Business section body in this fixture.

We operate through two reportable segments: Automation Systems and Aftermarket Services. Aftermarket Services carries higher gross margins and provides recurring revenue that partially offsets the cyclicality of new equipment orders.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. TOC-SENTINEL-RISK marks the real Risk Factors body in this fixture. You should carefully consider the risks described below together with the other information in this report.

Our results depend heavily on capital spending by a small number of large logistics customers. Three customers accounted for approximately 41% of consolidated revenue in fiscal 2025, and a deferral of automation projects by any one of them would materially reduce our order backlog and operating income.

We rely on a limited number of suppliers for precision motion components and semiconductors. Extended lead times or allocation decisions by those suppliers have in the past delayed shipments, and a recurrence could increase costs and delay revenue recognition into later periods.

Our indebtedness could limit our operating flexibility. As of June 30, 2025 we had approximately $1.86 billion of total debt outstanding, and the covenants in our credit agreement restrict our ability to incur additional debt, pay dividends above specified levels, and complete acquisitions without lender consent.

Short line.

Item 3. Legal Proceedings

We are party to routine litigation incidental to our business. TOC-SENTINEL-LEGAL marks the real Legal Proceedings body. In March 2025 a former distributor filed a claim alleging breach of an exclusivity arrangement; we believe the claim is without merit.

PART II

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

The following discussion should be read together with our consolidated financial statements. TOC-SENTINEL-MDA marks the real MD&A body in this fixture.

Revenue increased 6.9% to $6.20 billion in fiscal 2025, driven by a 9% increase in Automation Systems shipments and a 4% increase in Aftermarket Services. Operating margin expanded 90 basis points to 19.7% as mix shifted toward services and we realized savings from the plant consolidation announced in fiscal 2023.
